cc:Work.dc:description: Schematic plan and profile of the minimal river-mouth delta setup (sea as ordinary cells with an initial level, radiating far edge, channel between dry banks, inflow with mud and capacity sand feed), the mechanisms to switch on and the expected shapes for high and low mud concentration. Not solver output.
